snippet.title: Dream League Soccer 26 | LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
DLS26 is OUT NOW!

Explore all the new features, and get your hands on BRAND NEW Player Cards by updating now!
Join up with friends in all new CLANS to compete and earn rewards together.
Check out brand new commentary languages and enjoy the excitement in TURKISH and ARABIC.
Find brand new cutscenes, an updated stadium screen, and new player data for the 25/26 season!
Collect as many Special Cards as you like with unlimited Special Card accommodation!

Download here: https://www.ftgames.com/dls

Follow us on TikTok:   https://www.tiktok.com/@dreamleaguesoccer.ftg
Follow us on Instagram:   https://www.instagram.com/playdls/
Follow us on Facebook:   https://www.facebook.com/dreamleaguesoccer

#dls #dls26 #dreamleaguesoccer
